text.tspan: WIRING CONCEPT ONLY - NO ELECTRICAL ERC OR PCB LINK
R3 / R4: 100k GPIO pulldowns; R5: 220R PWM series; R6: 100k PWM pulldown
MCU and servo supply share GND. PhotoMOS outputs remain isolated from GND.
Use existing remote battery. Verify voltage, button topology and relay pinout before soldering.
